_note: The bc17 map pools. Every board is one of the seventy official
`data/maps/bc17/<Name>.json`. The 22 boards below are COMMITTED, the
`test` job re-runs the converter with `--check` and byte-diffs them, and
`parity-oracle-bc17`'s Tier B cross-checks every one against the JVM's
`mixed` is the bc17 variant's played pool and spans the axes the
doctrines argue about (archons per side 1/2/3, neutral trees 16..924,
trees holding bullets 0..892, archon separation 5.0..56.9); `small` is
what the parity oracle and the docker smoke run on; `large` is reserved
for a later variant and supplies one of the nine parity pairs.
